doneWhen.text: Closes M2 as specified in the Findings table of .maestro/specs/releases/0.10.1.md, within the patch-release rules there (additive API only; stricter defaults with a named dangerous/insecure opt-out). One regression test per finding, named after it (for example h1_per_ip_limit_sees_the_peer).
